- [RCTS.1.2.34] **`compile_error`'s `expected_line`** ([RCTS.1.2.10]) — a
  positive integer: the line of `rules_ds`, counting from 1, at which the
  refusal carrying the fixture's `code` begins. A code names a class of
  refusal, and `DS_PARSE_GENERIC` names nearly every parse refusal, so the
  code alone holds only that the program is refused. The line holds where.
  The field is optional, but a fixture whose `code` is `DS_PARSE_GENERIC`
  must carry it. A harness must fail the fixture unless the compiler, refusing the program
  with `code`, reports that refusal, or one of its refusals with `code`, as
  beginning on that line. It must fail a fixture of any other `expect.kind`
  that carries the field, one whose value is not a positive integer, and a
  `DS_PARSE_GENERIC` fixture without it.
